decision: Not registered. Root PM assigns the experiment ID and registers rules before any real-data fit or scoring.
frontier_row: Numerical-feature embeddings for the direct head (exploratory, D165); not an existing registered frontier ID
hypothesis: Periodic (PLR-lite) embeddings of the continuous direct-head inputs change the 2025 Cpanel DEV outcome distribution prediction of the frozen flatten-MLP EXP-P15-001 head, alone and in the fixed 1/2 mix with G0-global.
one_change: Input representation of 80 continuous scalars only (40 past-token physics, 40 continuous context): raw scalar -> 8-dim periodic embedding. Head kind flatten_mlp width 128 (Linear(n,256) GELU Linear(256,256) GELU Linear(256,10)), optimizer AdamW wd .01, budget, unweighted May 1-15 early stop, May 16-31 Cpanel temperature, June Cpanel frequency blend, Cpanel DEV and frozen whole-MLB DEV are EXP-P15-001. The first Linear widens with the input (286 -> 846).

literature.source: Gorishniy, Rubachev, Babenko 2022, On Embeddings for Numerical Features in Tabular Deep Learning
literature.official_code: https://github.com/yandex-research/rtdl-num-embeddings (package/rtdl_num_embeddings.py and package/README.md read at commit a8fc250; MIT license)
literature.fidelity: Adaptation, not reproduction: PLR with the README lite option (shared outer Linear), sigma .01 = package default called safe in the README, 16 frequencies and d_embedding 8 instead of package defaults 48/24 to bound head growth, truncated-normal(+-3 sigma) frequency init as in the package, trainable frequencies, no tuning, ten-class head, flattened token/mask/context contract, padded past physics embeddings masked to zero, current-pitch physics never embedded. Formula reimplemented; no third-party code copied.

candidate_architecture.exact_network: e=ReLU(Linear(32,8)(cat(cos,sin)(2*pi*c*x_num)))*mask, c ~ TruncNormal(0,.01,+-.03) per scalar [80,16]; logits=flatten_mlp(cat(raw 206, e.flatten 640))

input_map.token_embedded: physical channels 0-7 of past positions 0-4 (standardized effective_speed, release_spin_rate, spin_axis_sin, spin_axis_cos, pfx_x, pfx_z, plate_x, plate_z); embedding zeroed where the position is padded
input_map.token_raw: past type one-hot 8-26 and outcome one-hot 27-37; the whole current token (physics 0-7 zero by contract, candidate type, zero outcome); padding mask

context_reasons.embedded: 11-16 standardized batter style priors, 17-22 style reliabilities in [0,1], 23-27 soft archetype memberships, 28-31 standardized pitcher physical means, 33-50 standardized pitcher type proportions, 51 log1p(TRAIN count)/10
context_reasons.raw: 0-4 balls/strikes/outs/inning/score lead (integer ordinals), 5-10 binary flags (top, bases, batter/pitcher hand), 32 pitcher left-hand share (near binary)

candidate_architecture.fit_procedure: DirectPeriodicModel inherits DirectResidualModel.fit (tested mirror of MatrixModel.fit); only network factory, zero-current-physics guard and archive differ

future_confirmation: Seeds 3 and 4 only in a separate registered confirmation after root review. Equal-parameter raw-input control only as a follow-up (capacity vs representation).

mix.rule: candidate direct head and the frozen G0-global member of the same seed, member-wise 1/2, then the same June frequency blend; compared with the frozen G15 mix (EXP-P15-002 construction) of the same seeds

device: --device auto (default) = mps if available else cpu, the control rule. Explicit cpu/cuda is recorded in identity and preparation (comparable_device_to_control false for cpu/cuda); such scores are not comparable to the MPS control without a same-device control arm. No newsrv/GPU use for this family.
data_rules: No 2026 rows (runner date guard). TRAIN rows only for fitting; May/June Cpanel rows only for early stop, temperature and blend; DEV never used for fitting, calibration or selection.

secondary_descriptive: Cpanel DEV before the frequency blend
whole-MLB DEV calibrated three-seed mean (no June blend) when --mlb was run
parameter counts, best epoch and fit/predict seconds per seed
